claims.text: Excluding-Australia cumulative expected shortfall (ES95) of government revenue shortfall over the joint two-year horizon, expressed in billions of constant dollars.
Unscaled source value for the same excluding-Australia cumulative expected shortfall (ES95), as returned by the risk cell in constant dollars.
Assessment as-of date for the assessment containing the excluding-Australia cumulative ES95 risk cell.

limitations: The ES95 figures are positive-part tail shortfall measures of the revenue-loss distribution; signed mean losses retain gains, but VaR and ES are computed on the positive shortfall, so the tail values are not directly comparable to signed means.
The assessment is non-recomputable (inspection only) with incomplete historical input provenance, and models are not causally identified.
The ES95 applies only to conditional government revenue transmission linked to agriculture, forestry and fishing value added; it is not a total-economy loss and not a sovereign default probability.
Values are expressed in constant 2025 USD, GDP-deflated, at a fixed 2025 exchange rate; price and FX responses are not modeled.
The billion figure is a unit rescaling of the single unscaled source value; no separate conversion evidence was provided.
The assessment is conditional on the stated forecast vintage and macroeconomic path; official forecasts are marginal, not joint, and the extension is not a NOAA forecast.
